name: Heavy crane lift
summary: Permit, survey, lift plan, crane mobilisation and load test, the lift itself (bound to a BIM step), as-built survey and demobilisation attendance.

information: weight and centre of gravity data

steps.note: Crane position, ground bearing check and exclusion zone
Lifting permit and exclusion zone approval
Plan by an appointed person: weights, radii, rigging, weather limits
Crane base and mat design check
Toolbox talk, rigging inspection, weather check on the day
Positions of the set item against the design

logic.reason: The crane is selected from the plan
The lifted step runs between these two; bind it from the sector library

checks: Ground bearing confirmed under the crane and the load path
Weather limits stated and checked on the day
references: National lifting operations guidance (lift planning and appointed person duties)
Temporary works procedure guidance (design check, permit to load, permit to dismantle)
